schema.description: The cart to place. Exactly one of shipTo, shipToAddressId and pickupPointId is required: an inline address, the addressId of an address saved on the shopper (AddSavedAddress, copied into the order at placement), or a pickup point (ADR 0016 - the order carries no address at all and its destination prefix is the point's own, as the confirmed promise quoted it). Giving two or more, neither, an unknown id, the id of another shopper's address or an unregistered shopperId is 422 validation-failed.

shipTo.description: Synthetic PII. Returned only by GET /orders/{orderId}/ship-to; accepted on checkout and shopper registration.
shipTo.title: ShipTo

shipToAddressId.description: A saved address of this shopper; the address is copied into the order.

pickupPointId.description: The pickup point to check out to (ADR 0016): the order carries no ship-to, the promise is quoted against the point and the order's destination prefix is the point's own prefix. The offers must have been quoted to the same point.

items.description: One shipment group and the delivery offer the shopper saw for it.
items.title: CheckoutGroup

schema.title: CheckoutRequest
